sentences.en: Algeria should commit itself to reducing its greenhouse gas emissions.
sentences.zh: 阿尔及利亚应该致力于减少温室气体排放。

sentences.en: To be suitable for life, Mars needs a greenhouse atmosphere.
sentences.zh: 为了适宜居住，火星需要一个温室效应的大气层。

sentences.en: The neighbours have turned their balcony into a proper greenhouse.
sentences.zh: 邻居们把他们的阳台改造成了一座真正的温室。
